world.name: Grand Earth
world.descript: Grand Earth is world where a man may starve, over heat, freeze, die of thirst, and must rest from time to time. Grand Earth has weather and time. Grand earth will have different areas of forest, mountains, deserts, hills, islands, tropics, swamps, oceans, snowy tundra and icelands. In Grand Earth you may become fatigued both mentally and physically. You may be out of breath and drown or die. You have a given amount of physical injury or health. You may not see in the dark under normal circumstances without lighting. Enjoy your stay in the world of Grand Earth.
